bald = with little or no hair on the head
moustache = hair that grows above a man's mouth
wrinkles = lines on the skin that come with age
scar = a mark left on the skin after a cut heals
dimple = a small hollow in the cheek that shows when you smile
tall = of more than average height
short = of less than average height
medium height = neither very tall nor very short
well-built = with a strong, wide body
skinny = very thin, often in an unhealthy way
plump = a little fat, in a soft way
pretty = attractive, usually of a girl or woman
handsome = attractive, usually of a man or boy
ugly = unpleasant to look at
pale = with light skin, or looking ill
tanned = with darker skin after time in the sun
broad-shouldered = with wide shoulders
elderly = old, used politely about people
young = having lived for only a short time
adult = a person who is fully grown
